name: Kimpton Atlantico Algarve
insider_take: Where the drama of Portugal's golden cliffs meets the effortless cool of Kimpton's signature style — the Atlantico Algarve is the Algarve's most exciting new chapter.
whats_special: Perched along the spectacular coastline of the Algarve, the Kimpton Atlantico is a design-forward retreat that channels the raw, sun-bleached beauty of southern Portugal. As part of IHG's prestigious Destined Program, this property was thoughtfully crafted to reflect its dramatic surroundings — think terracotta tones, organic textures, and sweeping Atlantic views. The Algarve itself is legendary for its sea-carved limestone grottos, world-class golf, and some of Europe's most celebrated beaches, including the iconic Praia da Marinha just moments away. Kimpton's famously pet-friendly, inclusive hospitality philosophy fits perfectly with the laid-back, sun-soaked rhythm of Algarve life.
pro_tip: Take full advantage of Kimpton's complimentary evening Social Hour — it's the perfect sunset moment to sip local Vinho Verde while swapping tips with fellow travelers about hidden sea caves and secret coastal trails only locals know.
dont_miss: The Algarve's coastline is best explored by boat — ask the concierge to arrange a private grotto tour along the Benagil Cave sea stacks, one of Portugal's most breathtaking natural wonders. Back on land, the nearby town of Lagoa is worth a wander for its authentic azulejo-tiled churches and local market culture, offering a genuine taste of the Algarve beyond the beach.
pros: Breathtaking clifftop location overlooking the Atlantic Ocean with panoramic sea views
Stylish, design-forward rooms and suites reflecting Kimpton's signature boutique aesthetic
World-class dining experiences celebrating fresh Portuguese and Algarvian coastal cuisine
Exceptional wellness offerings including a serene spa and resort-style pool experience
Warm, personalized Kimpton service culture delivering genuinely memorable guest experiences
cons: Secluded clifftop setting may require a car or taxi for access to local towns and beaches
Premium luxury positioning reflects a higher price point relative to the broader Algarve market
